effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
